name: Luda
bio:
Lee Lu-da (Korean: 이루다; born March 6, 1997), better known by the mononym Luda, is a South Korean singer. She debuted as a member of South Korean-Chinese girl group WJSN under Starship and Yuehua Entertainment in 2016.

On March 3, 2023, Starship Entertainment announced Luda chosen not to renew her contract with the label however it wasn't explicitly stated if she had left the group.

credits.overview: A time travel romance across past and present, about a webtoon artist desperate for a hit and a palace maid who wants to become a royal concubine, connected by a mysterious cabinet.

credits.title: WJSN Fan-Con "Codename : Ujung"
credits.overview: WJSN Fan-Con -Codename : Ujung- is a fan concert held by WJSN. It was held on January 7, 2023 and on January 8, 2023 at Bluesquare Mastercard Hall. Being the second show live-streamed via Beyond LIVE.

credits.title: Parasite Challenge Double-Up WJSN
credits.overview: The parasite house is always peaceful. But in its attic are 10 parasites living in secret... Suddenly! They receive a mission in morse code. They must collect five Stones and escape the house! Will WJSN be able to succeed?

credits.title: WJSN Concert 2022 "Wonderland"
credits.overview: 2022 WJSN Concert 'Wonderland' is the third concert held by WJSN. It was held on June 11, 2022 at 6PM KST and on June 12, 2022 at 5PM KST offline at Olympic Hall and on June 12 online via Beyond LIVE.

credits.title: WJSN Secret Gathering : The Fake
credits.overview: The original entertainment series "Secret Gathering: The Fake" is a dramatic variety, in which a celebrity WJSN invited to the "Universe Secret Charity Auction 1000th Anniversary Event" notices that the party venue is an illegal venue for secret trading of sacred objects in the universe.
